messages.content: In plain English, what happens when I click Accept & send?
Sonderr sends the exact transaction shown on that review card. Check the network, recipient, asset, amount, and fee before accepting. The wallet card does not guarantee the transaction will settle.
Can you tell from this token’s name whether it is a scam?
No. A token name alone cannot establish whether it is legitimate or safe. The exact contract and network are needed for an evidence-based review, and even on-chain metadata cannot guarantee safety.
Show me the current git diff.
Rewrite this politely: “You forgot to attach the file.”
“It looks like the file may not have come through. Could you please attach it?”
Review the integration for security issues.
I’ll load the security-review playbook, inspect the relevant integration code, and report findings with evidence.
